The assistant that lives in your house.

Sparky is a small box on your shelf and a chat in Telegram. Ask it to remember something, plan the week, or set up a film library for the family — it does the technical part on hardware you own.

We’ll only use this to let you know when Sparky is available. How we handle your data.

One assistant. Every part of home life.

Sparky starts with a conversation. Then that conversation reaches into the things that matter: your plans, your memories, your meals, your entertainment, and the way your home works.

In the morning

“What do I need to know today?”

Sparky brings together the plans, reminders, messages, and priorities that deserve your attention.

During the day

“Remember this.”

Send Sparky a thought, a link, a voice note, or a half-formed idea, in the same Telegram chat you use for everything else. Find it again when it matters.

At home

“What should we cook this week?”

Save recipes wherever you find them, make a meal plan, and turn it into one shopping list for the family.

When someone recommends a film

“Add it to our library.”

Sparky sets up the film and TV library on its own disk and keeps it running — ready for the next movie night without another subscription or another app.

A place for the things you don’t want to lose.

Ideas, recipes, plans, conversations, family stories, and the small details that make life work. Sparky helps you keep them close and make sense of them.

It can actually do things, because it runs a real machine.

Most assistants can only answer. Sparky has a computer in your home behind it, so it can install software, block ads across the house, keep your media library and back it all up.

The intelligence of an assistant. The reach of a machine you own.

You tell Sparky what you want. Sparky handles the technical details, on a box that sits in your home.
